params.name: api-version
params.description: Version of the API to be used with the client request. The current version is 2019-04-01-preview.

params.name: $filter
params.description: May be used to filter aggregated cost by properties/usageStart (Utc time), properties/usageEnd (Utc time). The filter supports 'eq', 'lt', 'gt', 'le', 'ge', and 'and'. It does not currently support 'ne', 'or', or 'not'. Tag filter is a key value pair string where key and value is separated by a colon (:).

items.docs: Provides the aggregate cost of a management group and all child management groups by current billing period.
